entries.PRT-QL-001: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalB} in a {business} for the same period. In what ratio should they share the profit?
entries.PRT-QL-002: {partnerA} and {partnerB} ran a {business} throughout the year with investments of {capitalA} and {capitalB}, respectively. Find their profit-sharing ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-003: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalB} in a {business} for the same period. If the total profit was {totalProfit}, what was {targetPartner}'s share?
entries.PRT-QL-004: A {business} earned a profit of {totalProfit}. {partnerA} and {partnerB}, who invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for equal periods, divided it according to their investments. How much did {targetPartner} receive?
entries.PRT-QL-005: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in a {business}. If {targetPartner}'s share of the profit was {knownShare}, find the total profit.
entries.PRT-QL-006: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in a {business}. If the total profit was {totalProfit}, find the difference between their shares.
entries.PRT-QL-007: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, while {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB} in a {business}. Find their profit-sharing ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-008: In a {business}, {partnerA}'s capital was {capitalA} for {durationA} and {partnerB}'s capital was {capitalB} for {durationB}. In what ratio should the profit be divided?
entries.PRT-QL-009: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, and {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB} in a {business}. If the profit was {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-010: A {business} earned {totalProfit}. {partnerA} had invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, while {partnerB} had invested {capitalB} for {durationB}. How much profit did {targetPartner} receive?
entries.PRT-QL-011: {partnerA} invested some capital for {durationA}, while {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB} in a {business}. Their profit ratio was {profitRatioA}:{profitRatioB}. Find {partnerA}'s capital.
entries.PRT-QL-012: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for some time, while {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB} in a {business}. Their profit ratio was {profitRatioA}:{profitRatioB}. For how long did {partnerA} invest?
entries.PRT-QL-013: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for a full year in a {business}. {partnerB} joined after {joinAfter} with {capitalB}. Find their profit-sharing ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-014: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} in a {business} but left after {leaveAfter}; {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for the full year. If the profit was {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-015: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for a full year in a {business}. {partnerB} invested {capitalB} after joining later. Their profit ratio was {profitRatioA}:{profitRatioB}. After how many months did {partnerB} join?
entries.PRT-QL-016: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the start, {partnerB} joined after {joinAfterB} with {capitalB}, and {partnerC} joined after {joinAfterC} with {capitalC}. Find their profit ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-017: {partnerA} began a {business} with {initialCapitalA} and added {addedCapital} after {changeMonth}. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout the year. Find their profit ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-018: {partnerA} invested {initialCapitalA} in a {business} and withdrew {withdrawnCapital} after {changeMonth}. {partnerB} invested {capitalB} throughout the year. From a profit of {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-019: {partnerA} invested {initialCapitalA} in a {business} and added some capital after {changeMonth}. {partnerB} invested {capitalB} throughout the year. If their profit ratio was {profitRatioA}:{profitRatioB}, how much did {partnerA} add?
entries.PRT-QL-020: {partnerA} began a one-year {business} with {initialCapitalA} and later increased it to {finalCapitalA}. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. If their profit shares were equal, after how many months did {partnerA} increase the capital?
entries.PRT-QL-021: In a {business}, {partnerA}, {partnerB}, and {partnerC} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, {capitalB} for {durationB}, and {capitalC} for {durationC}, respectively. Find their profit ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-022: {partnerA}, {partnerB}, and {partnerC} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, {capitalB} for {durationB}, and {capitalC} for {durationC} in a {business}. If the total profit was {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-023: In a {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB}, and {partnerC} invested an unknown capital for {durationC}. Their profit ratio was {profitRatioA}:{profitRatioB}:{profitRatioC}. Find {partnerC}'s capital.
entries.PRT-QL-024: {partnerA}, {partnerB}, and {partnerC} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, {capitalB} for {durationB}, and {capitalC} for {durationC} in a {business}. If {targetPartner}'s profit share was {knownShare}, find the total profit.
entries.PRT-QL-025: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in a {business}. {partnerA} receives a salary of {salary} before the remaining profit is divided. If gross profit was {totalProfit}, find {partnerA}'s total receipt.
entries.PRT-QL-026: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for equal periods in a {business}. {partnerA} receives {commissionPercent}% of gross profit as commission before distribution. If gross profit was {totalProfit}, find {partnerB}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-027: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for equal periods in a {business}. From gross profit of {totalProfit}, {deduction} was donated before distribution. Find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-028: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for equal periods in a {business}. {partnerA} received a salary before the remaining profit was shared. If gross profit was {totalProfit} and {partnerA}'s final receipt was {finalReceipt}, find the salary.
entries.PRT-QL-029: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {initialCapitalA} and added {addedCapital} after {changeMonth}. {partnerB} joined after {joinAfter} with {capitalB}. If profit was {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-030: {partnerA} began a {business} with {initialCapitalA}, added {addedCapital} after {changeMonth}, and receives a salary of {salary} before distribution. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. If gross profit was {totalProfit}, find {partnerA}'s total receipt.
entries.PRT-QL-031: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the start, {partnerB} joined after {joinAfterB} with {capitalB}, and {partnerC} joined after {joinAfterC} with {capitalC}. If profit was {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-032: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the start and {partnerB} joined later with {capitalB}. From gross profit of {totalProfit}, {deduction} was deducted before distribution. If {partnerB}'s share was {knownShare}, after how many months did {partnerB} join?
